name: account-intel
description: Account Intelligence — the reverse of the channel syncs. Run /account-intel <company> to pull a full picture of an account: internal history (past comms, dropped conversations to revive, leads/MQLs, closed-lost with Jiminny stall analysis) and external hygiene/research (company profile, corporate structure, creative signals), plus an ROI Score and a Prospecting Readiness verdict (NOW! / why not / whatever). Fills the All Accounts hygiene properties, writes an intelligence block on the account page for BDRs (chat-only for non-sales), and — only on the BDR's explicit yes — revives dropped conversations into Conversation Hub with drafted (never sent) follow-ups. Resolves whichever team + person invokes it.
